title: Ethiopian Berbere Stew
description: A flavorful and spicy stew originating from Ethiopia, made with berbere spice blend, zesty tomatoes, and tender beef.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic, cook until softened, 5 minutes.
Add lemongrass and berbere spice blend, cook for 1 minute.
Add beef stew meat, cook until browned, 5 minutes.
Add zesty tomatoes, beef broth, and stew, bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot with injera bread or over rice.
